label: California pleading paper (Cal. Rules of Court, rules 2.100-2.119)
court_default: SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA
notes: Line 1 baseline 66pt from the top, 24pt leading, 28 numbered lines. Attorney or party block from line 1; court title on line 8 or below (rule 2.111(3)); title of the paper in the footer below the page number (rule 2.110).
